authorization: User authorized original remake/publication and unlimited generation; supplied third-party inputs still need provenance
ui_owner: M1; assets/remaster/ui excluded from this tool/workstream
paid_submission_policy: Planning tool never submits. Existing task/receipt match means restore/resume only. New production needs measured reference and art approval, not another budget approval.
grouping: Group related source paths into measured module/material/character/weapon families before commissioning; one file is not one paid task.

gate_contracts.source-baseline: Full authorized source set/version and VFS priority independently verified; demo/partial can never pass
gate_contracts.measurements: Pinned BSP/entity bounds plus reviewed connector/clearance drawings or explicit original specification; no perspective-image dimension inference
gate_contracts.provenance: Input/output hashes, owner/license/source, generation identity/model/task/request, actual cost or explicitly unreconciled cost
gate_contracts.prototype: Consistent front/back/left/right/top views, scale silhouette and team visibility inspected; every environment component starts here
gate_contracts.blender: Source GLB/master retained; topology/UV/material/scale checked; rig/weight/animation reviewed for articulated assets; non-3D audio uses explicitly reviewed N/A with evidence
gate_contracts.format: Engine-exported bytes loaded; static MD3 surface limits, character IQM contract, BSP/AAS and material/codec contracts checked
gate_contracts.visual: Comparison screenshots inspected at near/mid/far and movement; no texture noise, holes, silhouette drift, shimmer or accidental collision concealment
gate_contracts.web-hdr: Real WASM HDR map+asset rendering, no loader/default material/context-loss errors; evidence pins runtime PK3 hash
gate_contracts.web-ldr: Real WASM LDR same representative states and pinned hash; desktop GL is insufficient
gate_contracts.gameplay: Collision, pickups, spawn/teleport/jump/doors, weapon timing, animation events and bot reachability validated where applicable; N/A requires reviewer evidence
gate_contracts.archive: Source and recovery snapshot hash verify plus restore drill; separate off-orb durable copy acknowledged

batches.scope: All arenas and game modes; preserve brushes, collision, entities, triggers, item/spawn positions, portals, routes and timing separately from visual meshes
batches.format_gap: BSP inventory does not reconstruct editable MAP brushes; compiler/AAS rebuild and bot-route equivalence require map workstream
batches.measurement: BSP world/submodel bounds and entity origins are executable reference; measure actual connector planes/clearance before generating

batches.scope: Floors, walls, ceilings, corners, trim, stairs, ramps, bridges, platforms, door frames/leaves, arches, grates, pillars, lights, vents, pipes, cables, machinery, statues and decals; family reuse across every supplied map
batches.format_gap: Static MD3 tested only; compiler mesh ingestion/LOD/collision authoring remains separate. GLB/glTF is source, never direct engine delivery
batches.measurement: Map-specific BSP/brush/connector specification, grid and pivot; pillar sample 40 units/m is not universal evidence

batches.scope: Skyboxes, fog, water, slime, lava, portals, reflective/translucent surfaces and hazard boundaries
batches.format_gap: PBR must be baked/re-authored: no automatic roughness/metallic/emission equivalence; Q3 surface/content flags remain gameplay-owned
batches.measurement: Actual sky/fog/brush extents and hazard planes; shader time scale recorded

batches.scope: Every player/bot body, head, team/alternate skin, first-person hands; idle/run/walk/back/crouch/jump/land/swim/turn/gesture/pain/death/attack/weapon-switch animations
batches.format_gap: IQM-first; exporter/rig-retarget/game animation binding is NOT implemented by static tool. Generation does not guarantee topology, weights, motions or Q3 semantic compatibility; retain MD3 tags and animation.cfg as references, no MD3 character batch
batches.measurement: Source bounds/eye height/hitbox and actual tag transforms; root motion must not override authoritative player physics

batches.scope: Every weapon world/pickup/first-person mesh, hands, barrel, flash socket, projectile and ammo; idle/fire/recoil/reload-if-original/switch event alignment
outputs: engine model with tags or verified IQM attachment contract
batches.format_gap: One-frame static exporter cannot export animated weapons or tags. Need explicit animated/tag exporter or verified IQM client binding; avoid inventing reload/gameplay loops absent from original
batches.measurement: Source tag_weapon/tag_flash/tag_barrel transforms, first-person FOV and projectile origin; mesh scale never changes damage/recoil timing

batches.scope: Health, armor, powerups, objectives/flags, holdables, gibs and gameplay markers; distinct team silhouettes
outputs: static MD3 or verified animated export
batches.format_gap: Flags/cloth and animated pickups require animation exporter; static MD3 valid only for genuinely static subparts
batches.measurement: Entity item origin, bob/rotation range, collision/pickup volume from gameplay source

batches.scope: Muzzle flashes, impacts, trails, beams, explosions, smoke, sparks, blood, teleport/spawn/pickup/respawn effects, damage overlays; UI excluded
outputs: TGA sprite/frame atlas or MD3 mesh
batches.format_gap: Q3 particles/effect events remain code-owned; shader blending/depth/overdraw must be tuned in browser, not inferred from still-image API
batches.measurement: Original lifetime/velocity/radius/attachment and multiplayer event cadence; readable without hiding opponents

batches.scope: Weapon fire/impact/explosion/flyby, footsteps by material, jumps/land/pain/death/voice, pickups, doors/lifts/water/ambience, announcer/team events and music loops
outputs: engine PCM WAV or verified OGG
batches.format_gap: No audio generation/voice cloning/automatic mastering implemented or claimed. Verify origin/voice rights and codec support; audio uses cue prototypes, not meaningless image-to-3D
batches.measurement: Original cue lengths, loop points and event scheduling; positional mono versus music stereo explicitly tested

batches.scope: Shader name compatibility, texture/sky dependencies, animation stages and map metadata; shared reusable material families
batches.format_gap: Inventory parses common image directives, not all shader semantics; actual material compilation/default-texture log and runtime tracing required
batches.measurement: Source UV density, stage frequencies, blend/depth/sort and lightmap convention

exclusion_policy: UI/icons/menu cinematics assigned M1; VM/game/config/replay data owned by engine workstream. Report exclusions explicitly; do not count them as remade. Nested animation.cfg remains character input.
unclassified_policy: Any unmatched source path remains visible and blocks claiming all source paths assigned
